privacy.title: Privacy notice for inquiries
privacy.intro: This notice explains what happens to the details you send through the inquiry form on this site, which is run by the consulting firm that uses Selah.
privacy.collect: Your organisation's name, sector, size and ownership type, the optional commercial registration number, your name, role, email and phone, the services you're interested in, your message, and your answers to the six self-check questions. We don't accept files through the form.
privacy.why: Only to respond to your inquiry, check it for conflicts of interest, and decide whether and how the firm can help. We don't use it for marketing and we don't sell it.
privacy.who: The firm's administrators, and the one consultant they assign to your inquiry. Other clients never see it.
privacy.technical: To stop abuse, we keep a keyed one-way hash of your network address and browser, never the address itself, and allow a few inquiries per hour from one address.
privacy.keep: If we start working together, your inquiry becomes part of your client record. Otherwise the contact details and message are erased 12 months after the inquiry is closed, or 30 days for spam. We keep only anonymous figures, such as sector and size, for statistics.
privacy.rights: You can ask to see, correct or delete your details by replying to the email you receive from the firm, or by contacting the firm directly. Requests are answered within 30 days, in line with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law.
